protocol: one process per case; warm-up (fixed steps) -> 3 timing windows (wall clock, median) -> 1 profiling window reading per-step Chrono timers; Pardiso needs libomp.dll preload (make_system); MKL_NUM_THREADS set only in the child env ('def' = unset)

timer_definitions.wall_us_per_step: perf_counter around the step loop (L1 includes the Python ground-bushing hook)
timer_definitions.advance_minus_ls_us: GetTimerAdvance - ls_us (load Jacobians of bushings by finite differences, integrator bookkeeping)
timer_definitions.setup_us: GetTimerSetup (includes the SCM loader: ray casting, contact patches, forces)

full_scale_L1.model: superstructure (top auger) + 4 leg moving parts on ChLinkMotorLinearPosition (locked), SMC pad spheres (YAML kn/gn), crawler spheres (contact.crawler.*, layout at measurement: crawler_layout_at_measurement; 50 mm above floor in the levelled state: no crawler contact), 4 ChLoadBodyBodyBushingSpherical ground bushings + Python circular Coulomb hook; start: pads touching, unloaded (drop transient, not settled)

crawler_layout_at_measurement.note: measured with the crawler layout above; the YAML is now layout D (24 spheres, bench_case.py builds it). Step cost with layout D is re-measured in the S0 cost measurement (this benchmark was not re-run).

scm.model: same machine without floor plate and ground bushings; pads = cylinders of the pad bottom area (r 0.1846 m, h 0.025 m); SCMTerrain 8 m x 6 m, active domains: 4 pads (0.6x0.6x0.4 m) + 2 crawler strips; dt 1e-4 s; SMC system (no SMC contacts present)

soil_ASSUMPTION.source: test only: Wong, Theory of Ground Vehicles, Bekker table 'heavy clay 25 % moisture'
soil_ASSUMPTION.note: Janosi, elastic K and damping R are Chrono-demo-order values, not soil data

scm.scm_timer_unit: SCMTerrain GetTimer* return milliseconds (checked: ray_testing ms x 1e3 ~ Setup timer us)

crawler_layout_at_measurement.note: measured with the crawler layout above; the YAML is now layout D (24 spheres, bench_case.py builds it). Step cost with layout D is re-measured in the S0 cost measurement (this benchmark was not re-run).

models.grid: N bodies on a square grid, each on a ChLinkMotorLinearPosition to the floor (spherical guide, z = 1 mm sine), neighbours coupled by ChLoadBodyBodyBushingSpherical (k 1e6 N/m, c 1e3 N s/m): 2-D coupling through the bushing stiffness blocks
models.chain: N bodies in a chain joined by ChLinkLockSpherical, body 0 to the floor, each with a ground bushing at its COM, gravity: banded coupling through constraint Jacobians
